claims.text: The resort is in Cape Town's Victoria & Alfred Waterfront.

findings.quote: Our resort commands an enviable spot in the city's fashionable Victoria & Alfred Waterfront
overlooking the marina, with panoramic views of Table Mountain

claims.text: The hotel is next door to the Two Oceans Aquarium.

findings.quote: prime V&A Waterfront location next door to the Two Oceans Aquarium

claims.text: In the Marina Rise rooms, the bathroom can be separated from the bedroom by sliding panels.

findings.quote: The bathroom can be separated from the bedroom by sliding panels, or opened up for a greater sense of space.
findings.note: said of the Marina Rise rooms recommended just before

claims.text: The spa has private wet areas and a yoga pavilion in the garden.

findings.quote: private wet areas, and a yoga pavilion in the garden

claims.text: The gym offers personal trainers, boxing, bootcamp, yoga and mat-based pilates.

findings.quote: with personal trainers, the latest fitness equipment, boxing, bootcamp, yoga, mat-based pilates

claims.text: The kids' club offers arts and crafts, baking and cooking classes, outdoor games and supervised visits to the Two Oceans Aquarium.

findings.quote: The kids’ club offers art and crafts, baking and cooking classes, outdoor games and supervised visits to the next-door Two Oceans Aquarium.

claims.text: The resort partners with the neighbouring Two Oceans Aquarium Foundation on a baby sea-turtle rehabilitation programme.

findings.quote: partnering with the neighbouring Two Oceans Aquarium Foundation for a baby sea-turtle rehabilitation programme

claims.text: The resort's team can arrange airport transfers using a fleet of luxury cars.

findings.quote: Let our expert team arrange transfers from the airport to our resort. With a fleet of luxury cars at our disposal

claims.text: Ochre focuses on South African cuisine and local ingredients.

findings.quote: Ochre is the new everyday eatery focused on South African cuisine and local ingredients

claims.text: The Vista Bar and Lounge serves cocktails, high tea and light meals.

findings.quote: Vista Bar and Lounge, the social heart of the hotel where cocktails, high tea and light meals are served in great style

claims.text: The spa is situated on its own little island.

findings.quote: The spa is a destination in its own right, situated on its own little island

claims.text: The resort has panoramic views of Table Mountain.

findings.quote: overlooking the marina, with panoramic views of Table Mountain

findings.quote: His-and-hers hydrotherapy facilities each have a vitality pool, aroma-steam room, sauna, ice fountain and experience showers.

claims.text: The island suites are steps from the spa and the free-form infinity pool.

findings.quote: you’re steps from the spa, free-form infinity pool, and Isola Restaurant (hotel guests only)

claims.text: Even the entry-level rooms have an egg-shaped bath, rain shower and dual marble vanities.

findings.quote: Even the entry level rooms have an egg-shaped bath, rain shower, and dual marble vanities.
